ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the target region is an L shape composed of equal-sized squares: the bottom row has 5 squares, and the rightmost square has another column of squares extending upward; the black dot is located inside the 4th square from the left in the bottom row, that is, the square immediately to the left of the right-side vertical column. Below are given five pieces A, B, C, D, E. The boundaries and internal lines of each piece all show shapes composed of whole squares and half-square triangles, among which E is a horizontal piece composed of a left half-triangle, a middle whole square, and a right half-triangle. Reasoning: According to the method stated in the problem, divide the target L shape into a unit-square/half-square grid, and place all rotatable, flippable, and translatable positions of A, B, C, D, E within the target shape to do an exact-cover check, requiring the entire L shape to be covered with no overlap and no gaps. In a feasible covering, piece E is placed horizontally near the right of the bottom row, and its middle whole square exactly covers the 4th square from the left in the bottom row, which is the square where the black dot is located. Therefore the black dot falls on piece E.

method.method_draft: Use a grid/exact-cover tiling approach. First read the target shape from the image as an L-shaped arrangement of unit squares: five squares along the bottom row, with a vertical column rising from the rightmost square; the dot is in the fourth bottom-row square from the left, immediately left of the vertical column. Then trace each piece A, B, C, D, and E using the visible square/triangular subdivisions. Generate all placements of each piece inside the L-shape under the allowed rigid motions, keeping all vertices aligned to the unit/half-unit grid. Enforce that the five pieces cover the whole L-shape with no overlap and no gaps. In the resulting valid tiling, the region containing the dotted square is occupied by piece E, so the piece lying on the dot is E.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中目标区域是由等大的方格组成的 L 形：底边一排有 5 个方格，最右边方格向上还有一列方格；黑点位于底边从左数第 4 个方格内，也就是紧挨右侧竖列左边的那个方格。下方给出五块拼片 A、B、C、D、E，各拼片边界和内部线条都显示出由整方格和半方格三角形组合而成的形状，其中 E 是一个横向拼片，由左半三角形、中间整方格、右半三角形组成。推理：按题设方法把目标 L 形划分为单位方格/半方格网格，并把 A、B、C、D、E 的所有可旋转、翻转和平移的位置放入目标形状内做 exact-cover 检查，要求无重叠、无空缺地覆盖整个 L 形。可行覆盖中，拼片 E 横放在底排靠右位置，它的中间整方格正好覆盖底排从左数第 4 个方格，即黑点所在方格。因此黑点落在拼片 E 上。
